news.analysis: The Steelers weren't able to get it done on Sunday night, suffering a big loss at the hands of the Bengals. Rodgers had a decent performance in that game with two touchdowns and no turnovers, but he still made his fair share of mistakes and wasn't able to lead the offense to many points scored. Moving forward he should continue to be regarded as nothing more than a streaming option for fantasy purposes.
